name: Proof of life

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

summary: Ysida gives the rescuer her locket to carry back to Anthion. She believes he perished while trying to save her, and the token is her proof that she remains alive. When the message reaches the roadside ghost, Anthion learns that the rescue succeeded. Their reunion is brief and divided by death, yet Ysida’s survival releases him from the fear that held him there. He can now offer help in the work that remains.
